claims: The process-phase skill text (skills/milestone/process-phase/SKILL.md) and skills/phase/process-phase/references/close.md now say, for each reread: line, to edit does or verbs, or to add or update the entry's reread: line, and to name the entries in the record too; no shipped text still sends the answer only to the record or the commit body.
changed and review read one rule: both now read one set, DATING, in components_index.py.

An entry whose code changed with only notes, tests, modules (or any other field) edited now gets its reread: line, and the line names what was edited; with nothing edited it still reads (entry not edited), so the capture on the site is unchanged.
An entry with does, verbs or flow edited, or a reread: line added or updated, gets none. A reread: line that was already there at the base, unchanged, does not answer a new change.
An entry absent at the base is still 'written in this change'.
A subsystem whose member changed follows the same rule for whether its line is printed: an edit to its components or notes alone does not answer it.

From plugin 0.1.8, changed --strict exits 1 while a component's reread: line is left. A subsystem's reread: line is advice: it is printed and never fails, with or without --strict. The plain changed is unchanged in what it exits with: it prints the lines and exits 0.
The note: line appears only when a line that fails is left, and the summary says how many of the lines are subsystems; with none it reads as it did before.

Every page that describes the changed behaviour is updated in this pull request (skills/components/SKILL.md, the two process-phase texts, examples/components-check.yml, docs/components.html, the --strict help string), and skills/components/references/review.md needed no change.
plugins/ is what devtools/build_plugins.py generates from the product, at version 0.1.8.
Ten of the first commit's tests fail on main (31249da) for the reasons the issue gives. Five of the second commit's fail on the first commit's script.

The record .planning/milestones/reread-answers/001-issue-50.md was written after the code and says so; it claims no plan, plan review, spec gate, review round or close that did not happen, and every gate it cites is one a reader can rerun at the commit it names.
